include_condition: offer_eligible=true; no Live, PP, Skeptic or Risk
remove_condition: offer sent; session started; blocker opened; sale closed
compatibility_or_priority: Hidden by Live PP Skeptic Risk
manual_override: No direct badge override; underlying sale decision with audit
notes: Internal signal for Expert/Agent to offer paid consultation

include_condition: session started and status is active, paused or reconnecting; connecting is not Live
remove_condition: manual completion by Expert/Agent or terminal/technical end after timeout
compatibility_or_priority: Hides Sell; remains during pause and reconnect
notes: Temporary pause or reconnect does not remove Live

include_condition: client started wallet top-up or checkout; payment status pending processing or requires_action
remove_condition: succeeded failed cancelled expired or TTL
default_ttl_or_window: 60m or provider TTL, whichever is earlier
compatibility_or_priority: Hides Sell; can coexist with Paid Live Trial
notes: Temporary signal: do not distract a client currently paying

include_condition: at least one confirmed successful wallet top-up exists in client history
remove_condition: Only by explicit financial rollback or chargeback policy; not by consultation completion
compatibility_or_priority: Compatible with PP Live Trial Revive; does not require a consultation
notes: Not a consultation debit and not pair-scoped

include_condition: active consultation trial phase with remaining minutes greater than zero
remove_condition: trial exhausted expired or session leaves trial
compatibility_or_priority: May coexist with Live and Paid
notes: Trial is a phase of the same consultation

remove_condition: case resolved closed accepted or declined
manual_override: Underlying case only; mandatory reason and audit

include_condition: active revive_context for return to an unfinished or resumable context
remove_condition: client returned and session active; context closed or expired
compatibility_or_priority: Compatible with Paid; does not arise from Paid or PP alone
notes: Exact opening event must be implemented explicitly

include_condition: unresolved policy support safety or quality incident for the pair
remove_condition: incident resolved closed or expired by policy
compatibility_or_priority: Hides Sell; Safe may replace it in Chats
manual_override: Staff or super-admin changes incident with reason and audit

include_condition: positive safety decision after review with author reason time and scope
remove_condition: new Risk; new review; decision expiry
compatibility_or_priority: Replaces Risk only in Chats; never shown in Pings
manual_override: Staff or super-admin decision with mandatory audit

include_condition: bonus or compensation coupon/credit grant is committed and currently valid
compatibility_or_priority: Does not hide Sell; request or available discount alone is insufficient
manual_override: No direct badge override; grant must be audited
notes: Open coupon_request is an internal process, not this badge

remove_condition: next freshness band; handling; conversion; close; expiry
compatibility_or_priority: Fire > Hot > NEW; only one freshness badge

remove_condition: NEW band; handling; conversion; close; expiry

include_condition: client has at least one confirmed successful wallet top-up
remove_condition: Only by explicit financial rollback or chargeback policy
compatibility_or_priority: Compatible with other non-conflicting Pings badges
notes: Same global Paid fact as Chats; not paid intent for a particular lead

include_condition: client sent first message or action that requires Expert response
remove_condition: Expert response saved; conversion; close; expiry
notes: If client sends the first message, the item is Chats with Reply, not Pings

include_condition: Expert outreach is saved and delivered; client response is expected
notes: Expert outreach alone does not convert Ping to Chats

remove_condition: client returns; context closed; context expires
compatibility_or_priority: Contextual; does not replace Reply or Await
notes: Exact opening event must be implemented explicitly

include_condition: unused trial entitlement exists and remaining minutes are greater than zero
remove_condition: trial activated exhausted expired; lead converted or closed
compatibility_or_priority: May coexist with freshness and Paid
notes: In Pings it means available entitlement, not an active timer

include_condition: active risk incident belongs to the Ping or its client-expert pair
compatibility_or_priority: Safe is never shown in Pings
manual_override: Staff or super-admin decision with mandatory audit
